description: Save or update a structured, machine-readable test case definition under .androidmcp-framework/testcases/. Stores pre-conditions, step actions, targets, assertions, and metadata.

description.description: Detailed description and goal of the test case.

overwrite.description: Must be true to overwrite an existing test case file.

prerequisites.description: Prerequisites, e.g. ["User is logged in as Distributor", "Device is unlocked"].

steps.description: Ordered list of test steps with actions and expected outcomes.

testCaseJson.description: Optional custom raw JSON data to merge or store.

title.description: Human-readable title of the test case.

name: save_test_case
title: Save Test Case
